IMPORTANT: Folio 2v carries no new writing of its own. Everything visible is mirror-reversed show-through (or offset) of the ink on folio 2r, the 'previous page'. The pieces that match are: 'Entfernung', 'a', 'c', the triangle sketch with alpha and beta, the pentagon ABCDE with diagonals, 'geht durch die Punkte', the list of points, and the block of linear relations ending in 'Correspondirende'. Read correctly, the content is identical to 2r, so the reconstruction below is of that shared content.

(1) Sketches. The first is a triangle ABC with transversal markings +alpha (near B) and -beta (near A). The second is a pentagon A, B, C, D, E with diagonals. The note 'geht durch die Punkte' (passes through the points) lists points on the sidelines as linear combinations of the vertices, for example alpha C - (1-alpha) B, (alpha-1) B + alpha C, (gamma-1) A, gamma B, epsilon A. This is a Menelaus-type set-up: points on the sides given by vertex weights, and a line through them.

(2) Algebra. Points are treated as vectors, with affine (weight-sum-preserving) relations. In every relation below the coefficients on each side have equal sums.

(i) (ps-qr) A = p(q+s) c - q(p+r) b, so A lies on line bc.

(ii) (q+s-ps+qr) A + q(q+s-ps+qr) C = (1+q)(q+s-ps+qr) d. This is A + qC = (1+q) d, so d lies on AC.

(iii) (q+qr-qs) A + q(q+s-ps+qr) C = q(1+q+r-ps+qr) e, so e lies on AC.

(iv) Subtracting (iii) from (ii) eliminates C: s(1-p+q) A = (1+q)(q+s-ps+qr) d - q(1+q+r-ps+qr) e.

(v) Multiply (i) by s(1-p+q) and (iv) by (ps-qr), then subtract to eliminate A:
0 = ps(q+s)(1-p+q) c - qs(p+r)(1-p+q) b - (ps-qr)(1+q)(q+s-ps+qr) d + (ps-qr) q (1+q+r-ps+qr) e.
This is a linear dependence among the four points b, c, d, e with zero coefficient sum.

(vi) 'Correspondirende': the corresponding relation for the capital points is 0 = sC - rB - D + (1+r-s) E. Its coefficients sum to zero, so it is a legitimate affine relation.

Context: the next leaf is headed 'Newtons Kegelschnitts Construction'. That suggests these relations belong to a pentagon / projective-correspondence set-up, i.e. Newton's organic construction of a conic through five points, worked in barycentric/vector form.
errors: No slip found in the chain as written on 2r. Each relation preserves coefficient sums. (ii) minus (iii) gives exactly s(1-p+q)A. The elimination of A in (v) is exact.
